description: This file defines the MenuDao class responsible for database operations related to menu items within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for enabling/disabling menu items, retrieving menu items by various criteria, and managing menu hierarchy and permissions.

classes.name: MenuDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for interacting with menu items and related entities in the database, providing methods to enable/disable menu items, retrieve menu items by module, screen, title, role, and hierarchy.

methods.name: enableModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Enables all menu items for a given module, optionally filtered by menu titles.

methods.name: updateStatusOfModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Private method that updates the status (enabled/disabled) of specified menu items associated with a module, filtering by menu titles if provided.

methods.name: getMenuItemByModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Retrieves a menu item based on module and screen name.

methods.name: getSidePanelMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves side panel menu items accessible to given user roles at level 1.

methods.name: getTopMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves top-level menu items (level 2) under a specified side menu item, including nested child items.

methods.name: getMenuItemQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Helper method to generate a query builder for menu items filtered by user roles and permissions.

methods.name: getMenuItemByTitle
methods.description: Fetches a menu item by its title, optionally filtering by its hierarchy level.

methods.name: getModuleByName
methods.description: Retrieves a module entity by its name.
